messages.text:
## What failed
Dead or Alive 2 (game_id 1de2e7634f3161ff, dreamcast) with mod doa2_roster_59d8ed0e on JAYBUILTFINALE (windows), emulator retroarch. launch_game job a1b2c3d4e5f60789 failed.
